name: priceloop
description: Competitor prices and stock for your online store, from Priceloop.

interface.longDescription:
Priceloop finds the other online stores that sell your products and reads their price and stock every day. Connect it to ask about your competitors in plain words: which products someone sells cheaper than you, who sold out, what changed this week, and the full competitor list for a product with its price history.

For online stores that sell other brands' products and use Priceloop. Sign in with your Priceloop account and pick one store; ChatGPT then reads that store's data. The connection only reads: it cannot change prices, products or settings. Prices are in US dollars. Data is as fresh as Priceloop's last daily read of each page.
defaultPrompt: Which of my products is someone selling cheaper than me?
What did my competitors change this week?
Who sold out of my products in the last 7 days?

positive.description: Overview of the store's competitive position
positive.prompt: How am I doing against my competitors?
positive.expected_behavior: Names the store (SGV Bicycles), the number of watched products and competitors, how many products have a cheaper competitor in stock, and the counts of changes in the last 7 days.

positive.description: Products where a competitor in stock is cheaper
positive.prompt: Which of my products is someone selling cheaper than me, and are they in stock?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the watched products where an in-stock competitor is cheaper, each with the store's price, the cheapest competitor's name and price, and the percent difference.

positive.prompt: Show me every store selling the KMC Z8.1 chain, with price and stock.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the KMC Z8.1 Chain 8 Speed by its title and lists the competitors with price, stock, link and when each page was last read.

positive.prompt: What did my competitors change in the last 30 days?
positive.expected_behavior: Summarizes the changes newest first: price drops and rises, sold out and restock, new and gone competitors, with the product, the store and the before and after values.

positive.prompt: How has the price of the SE Bikes Basher 16 changed at competitors over the last 90 days?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the SE Bikes Basher 16" Kids Bike and reports the competitors' price history with include_history, or says that a competitor's price did not change.

negative.description: Changing a price is not supported: the plugin only reads
negative.prompt: Lower my price on the SE Bikes Big Flyer to $799.

negative.description: Another store's private data is not available: a connection reads only the store picked at sign-in
negative.prompt: Show me Walmart's sales numbers and their cost for the KMC chain.

negative.description: Writing store content is not supported: Priceloop reads competitor data and has no tool for copywriting, so ChatGPT should answer on its own without calling Priceloop
negative.prompt: Write a product description for the KMC Z8.1 chain on my store.

review.commerce_description: Priceloop reports competitor prices and stock. It does not sell products or process payments in ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: First release: store summary, products with the cheapest competitor in stock, competitors for a product with 90-day price history, and recent competitor changes.
